author: smcarus
title: Will Kenya's inflation be lower in 2026 than in 2025?
summary: Give the probability that IMF WEO average consumer price inflation for Kenya is lower for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 May 2027 (after the April 2027 WEO). Food and fuel prices weigh heavily in Kenya's consumer prices.
knownLimits: The 2026 figure in the April 2027 WEO is still an IMF estimate and may be revised later; the first reading stands.
Kenya must be on your watchlist for its latest figure to show on this page; the result is settled from the published series either way.
